title: Cybersecurity Fundamentals
description: Defend a small organisation from the threats it actually faces. Tests phishing awareness, vulnerability assessment, and incident response playbook design.

seo.overviewBody: Cybersecurity specialists protect organization networks against ransomware, data breaches, and insider threats. Employers look for hands-on skills in vulnerability scanning (Nessus/Qualys), SOC incident triage, Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR), and firewall rules.

deliverables.title: 1. Enterprise Threat & Vulnerability Report
deliverables.desc: Vulnerability assessment report detailing CVE severity scores, affected assets, and patch prioritization.

deliverables.title: 2. EDR & Firewall Security Policy Config
deliverables.desc: Firewall rule configuration file and EDR endpoint policy enforcing zero-trust access controls.

deliverables.title: 3. SOC Incident Triage & Response Playbook
deliverables.desc: Step-by-step incident response playbook for containing malware outbreaks and investigating suspicious login alerts.

faqs.question: What is the Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS)?
faqs.answer: CVSS provides a standardized numerical score (0.0 to 10.0) reflecting the severity, exploitability, and impact of software security vulnerabilities.

faqs.question: How does Zero Trust Architecture differ from traditional perimeter security?
faqs.answer: Traditional security assumes everything inside the corporate network is trustworthy. Zero Trust operates under a never trust, always verify model for every request.

faqs.question: Why is Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) preferred over basic antivirus?
faqs.answer: Basic antivirus relies on known signature matching. EDR monitors continuous behavioral telemetry to detect and isolate novel zero-day attacks.
